chunks: I have been sent as a trusted messenger to you.
ai.seo_question: What does the title 'Rasool Ameen' signify in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this declaration underscores the concept of 'Amanah' (trustworthiness) as a divine attribute transferred to the Prophet and the Ahl al-Bayt, validating their authority as infallible guides. It serves as a foundational proof for the Prophet's mission, contrasting his divine trust with the skepticism of the Quraysh poets and elites who questioned his message.
